scientific_integrity: The explicit orbit-stabilizer proof and Euler-product limit argument support the mathematical assertions; exhaustive finite checks supplement but do not certify the infinite result. Authorship and independent validation are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two fixed distinct nilpotent Jordan lengths; no claims of a single unconditioned parity limit, of uniformity in field order or lengths, or of full priority over unindexed work. Computational checks cover five small configurations only.
title: Independent theta coordinates for idempotents centralizing two-length Jordan forms
